fake-responses.who-is-damien:
I'm **Damien Demontis**, a 22-year-old full-stack developer passionate about technology and innovation. 🚀

Currently pursuing my **Expert in Information Technology** degree at Epitech Nancy (class of 2025), I'm also a **Pedagogical Advisor** for MSc students, training them in modern technologies like Nuxt, Docker, and Kubernetes.

My journey took me to **South Korea** for an exchange year at Keimyung University, where I was an Epitech ambassador and specialized in AI, VR/AR, and game development. This experience reinforced my **dream of living in Asia**! 🌏

I master numerous technologies: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C/C++, as well as modern frameworks like React, Vue.js, and Django. My flagship project, **Leon'Art**, is a student startup I co-founded to revolutionize the digital art market.
